title: bug: `WishartCholesky.infer_shapes` assumes tuples instead of supporting arrays
author: Qazalbash

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body: It is expected because `infer_shapes` accepts tuples of ints as arguments.

comments.author: Qazalbash
comments.body: Then the parameters should be renamed in the `infer_shapes` method such that they convey that there should be a tuple of ints instead of arrays.

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body: Maybe we can enhance the docstring? We would like to keep the parameter names as is for some inference logic

comments.author: Qazalbash
comments.body: Sure, we can do that too.

comments.author: tillahoffmann
comments.body: While updating the docstring, we should also have a look at the corresponding type hints from #2032.

comments.author: Qazalbash
comments.body: I got to this issue while solving these type hint bugs from #2032. I have solved around 70% of them. I will make sure changes required to reflect the discussion under this issue are also there.
